ei.title: Let Bears Bear the Right to Live Freely
ei.subject: 공통영어2

fullPassage: Let Bears Bear the Right to Live Freely Bears are a fascinating group of animals with eight species, all living in very different habitats around the world. Polar bears, for example, live in the Arctic, whereas Andean bears live in South America. These bears should have the freedom to live, but they are often killed when they come into contact with humans. One of the worst examples of this is bear bile farming. Brown bears in Eurasia and North America, Sun bears in Southeast Asia, and Asiatic black bears in Asia are often hunted and kept illegally for their bile, which is sold at a high price for traditional Asian medicine. Although bile farming is prohibited in many countries, it continues due to the constant demand. Governments and animal welfare organizations make persistent attempts to find these farms and rescue the bears, allowing them to live in bear sanctuaries or other safe places. Since UNESCO stated in 1978 that animals are born with the right to be respected, progress has been made in animal rights. However, some animals are still not fully protected outside the law, and need more of our attention and care.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: allow(동사 원형) → allowing(현재분사): 앞 절과 이어지는 분사구문으로, and they allow them to live의 의미를 분사구문 allowing them to live로 나타낸다. '그들이 ~에 살도록 허용하면서'라는 뜻이다.
det.tip: 분사구문: rescue the bears, allowing them to live = 곰을 구조하여 ~에 살도록 허용하다

questions.passage: Since UNESCO stated in 1978 that animals are born with the right to be __________ (respect), progress has been made in animal rights. However, some animals are still not fully protected outside the law, and need more of our attention and care.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: respect(동사 원형) → respected(과거분사): 「to be + 과거분사」 수동태 부정사 형태로, the right to be respected(존중받을 권리)가 된다. 동물이 존중을 '받는' 대상이므로 수동태를 쓴다.
det.tip: the right to be respected: 존중받을 권리 (to be p.p. 수동)

questions.passage: Let Bears Bear the Right to Live Freely Bears are a fascinating group of animals with eight species, all living in very different habitats around the world.  Polar bears, for example, live in the Arctic, whereas Andean bears live in South America.  These bears should have the freedom to live, but they are often killed when they __________ humans.  One of the worst examples of this is bear bile farming.  Brown bears in Eurasia and North America, Sun bears in Southeast Asia, and Asiatic black bears in Asia are often hunted and kept illegally for their bile, which is sold at a high price for traditional Asian medicine.  Although bile farming is prohibited in many countries, it continues due to the constant demand.  Governments and animal welfare organizations make persistent attempts to find these farms and rescue the bears, allowing them to live in bear sanctuaries or other safe places.  Since UNESCO stated in 1978 that animals are born with the right to be respected, progress has been made in animal rights.  However, some animals are still not fully protected outside the law, and need more of our attention and care.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 come into contact with(~와 접촉하다)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① take care of: ~을 돌보다 부적합
❌ ② run out of: ~을 다 써버리다 부적합
❌ ③ get rid of: ~을 제거하다 부적합
✅ ④ come into contact with: ~와 접촉하다 ← 정답
det.tip: when they come into contact with humans: 그들이 인간과 접촉할 때

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 at a high price(높은 가격에)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① on a large scale: 대규모로 부적합
❌ ② in a short time: 짧은 시간에 부적합
✅ ③ at a high price: 높은 가격에 ← 정답
